items.title: Game Guide: UAB
items.summary: PHILADELPHIA – Temple football returns to Lincoln Financial Field on Saturday, November 14, to host UAB for Senior Day and Family Day. Kickoff is set for 1:00 p.m. ET, with the game streaming on ESPN+ and available to listen to at OwlSports.com/listen. The Owls enter at 2-7 (1-4, American), while the Blazers are 5-4 (3-2, American). Temple will recognize 23 seniors during a pregame ceremony.

items.title: Bermudez Makes History; Temple Falls to Navy on the Road
items.summary: ANNAPOLIS, Md. – Temple erased a 28-point deficit and tied Navy late in the fourth quarter, but the Midshipmen scored with 1:14 remaining to edge the Owls, 42-35. Temple falls to 2-7 overall and 1-4 in American Conference play, while Navy improved to 3-6 and 2-4.
